Refund information

A clearer view.
Before you pay.

Check before you pay.

Review the plan, subscription term, number of streams and total. If you need to confirm a channel or device, ask before making a payment.

Need help with a purchase?

Prepare a request with your order reference, purchase date and the issue you are experiencing. Do not include a full payment card number, password or unredacted playlist URL.

Trial and service issues.

The 24-hour trial is a shorter way to check your setup before a longer subscription. Ask about the refund conditions applicable to your order before payment. No fixed refund period or unconditional guarantee is advertised here.
